8 recurring group rides around Los Angeles, CA: 6 road, 2 social, 2 mixed. 1 roll on weeknights, 6 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Venice Electric Light Parade in Los Angeles — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? La Grange Women's Ride runs social, 16–18 mph on flats, regroups.
